## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Mechanics Focus"}
The base assignment evaluates a straight prismatic member under static loading. Local support contact, connections, member self-weight, technician motion, impact, vibration, fatigue, instability, and regulatory access-system design are intentionally reserved for later analysis.
:::
